pwa.installTitle: Add Farfartaxi to your home screen
pwa.installLead: Install the app for quick access and a full-screen experience, like a native app.
pwa.installBodyChrome: Your browser can install the app in one step. You can also use the browser menu later.
pwa.manualIntro: There’s no quick install button here. Use your browser’s menu instead:
pwa.manualIos: iPhone/iPad: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.manualAndroid: Android: open the menu (⋮) and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
pwa.manualDesktop: Desktop: use the install icon in the address bar or the browser menu (e.g. “Install Farfartaxi” / Apps).
pwa.helpCalloutLead: Open the menu (☰) and choose “Add to Home Screen”, or follow the steps for your device below.

help.title: Help & FAQ
items: Menu (☰) → “Add to Home Screen”, or use the prompt after you log in.
Drivers should keep the app open for better live ETA via GPS.
Use “Share trip” to share ETA with family.
help.footer: Farfartaxi is family-friendly, fast, and fun to use.
